versions.changelog:
- Initial release of recall-markdown-memory skill for read-only Markdown memory retrieval.
- Uses mdselect CLI to extract relevant sections from user-specified or conventional memory files.
- Checks for mdselect availability and provides installation guidance if missing.
- Selects memory sources based on user input, project instructions, or standard locations.
- Recalls only the minimal necessary Markdown sections using heading-aware selection.
- Avoids modifying memory files; output includes source references for recalled context.
